stock.description: Yuzhou Group Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding entity, primarily concentrating on real estate development activities throughout the People's Republic of China. Its business is structured across five key segments: property development, property investment, property management, hotel operations, and other related services. The company actively participates in the entire property lifecycle, including the creation, sale, management, and investment of various real estate assets. Additionally, its operations encompass the running of hotels, marketing initiatives, and the trade of construction materials. The firm, established in 1994, has its headquarters located in Shanghai, PRC, and was previously known as Yuzhou Properties Company Limited until its name change in June 2020.
